articles.title: Senators Agree on Plan to Build Energy Projects Faster
articles.summary: Senators from both parties made a deal to speed up building power plants and power lines. The bill would also make AI data centers pay for the extra electricity they use. A vote comes after the November elections.

articles.title: Pentagon to Cut 20% of Top Military Generals and Admirals
articles.summary: U.S. War Secretary Pete Hegseth announced the military will cut 20% of its generals and admirals by January 2027. He also created a new command for robots and drones. Some lawmakers call it a 'purge.'

articles.title: Trump Administration Reverses Disability Integration Rules
articles.summary: For 50 years, federal rules said people with disabilities should live and work in the community, not institutions. The Trump administration just took a step to reverse that. Advocates are upset.
